purpose: Canonical navigable index and append-only decision history for research continuity. Read this journal before proposing another COSMOS detector change. Each stage keeps its own exact receipts, code, protocols and artifacts; this index pins their observed versions and does not replace them.

rules.append_only: Append a new event for each launch, calibration lock, result, failure, correction, hold or next hypothesis; do not erase earlier negative outcomes. Separate stage receipts may be updated with new verified results; pin old blob or commit here. Never record unobserved results as PASS.

negative results; technical errors and fixes

compare matched inputs and report realized controls
